svg.title: AWS IAM security review: exports, offline checks, triage and verified fixes
svg.desc: The Harbor Goods engineer exports IAM, CloudTrail and S3 configuration with read-only access. The reviewer runs 17 offline checks and Checkov, getting 27 raw hits, which triage consolidates into 9 ranked findings in a report with a SOC 2 evidence map. Fixes ship as policies, an SCP and Terraform through the client's pull requests, and the re-checked after state shows 0 findings and 0 failed Checkov checks.
svg.text: HARBOR GOODS · AWS IAM SECURITY REVIEW
